Service category: Office furnishing rental (Tiverton Office Rentals)
Rating: 4 out of 5
Rental period: 9 weeks
Account type: Business (verified)
Posted: March 14
Nothing I read before booking told me where the limits of this arrangement lie, so I am setting them out here.
Our lease ended nine weeks before the new floor was ready, and buying desks we would then store would have cost more than renting. We took 24 pieces. Delivery staff removed the protective covers on arrival.
The desks and seating were sound. The three storage cabinets, though, were too shallow to hold our files upright. An exchange must be requested while at least fourteen days of the term remain, and we were inside that window, so I asked for deeper units. They arrived four days later rather than the next business day. I claimed nothing off the invoice and booked a second short rental in February.
The total came to $2,150, which our relocation budget
covered
easily, though delivery and pickup are billed separately and the rate list does not say so.
In my view, then, this kind of rental works well for short projects that need standard desks and seating, but it is a poor fit for teams with unusual storage needs or for terms of under three weeks.
